name: High-Value Goods (Art, Jewellery, Precious Metals, Luxury Vehicles)
description: Purchase, trade and storage of portable, high-value assets, often with cash, to convert and store proceeds. Price subjectivity and confidentiality make valuation and origin hard to verify.

sources.text: FATF, Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing in the Art and Antiquities Market (2023)
FATF, Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Risks and Vulnerabilities Associated with Gold (2015)
FATF, Guidance on the Risk-Based Approach for Dealers in Precious Metals and Stones (2008)

indicators.name: Cash or third-party payments for high-value items
indicators.canon: High-value purchases paid in cash, crypto or non-standard funds
indicators.desc: High-value assets are bought with cash, crypto, third-party or otherwise non-standard funding.
indicators.ctx: Payments in cash, or from unrelated parties.
indicators.fp: Cash sales are legal in some places.

indicators.name: Price disproportionate to value
indicators.canon: Transaction price materially different from market value
indicators.desc: Price paid differs sharply from market value, comparable sales or estimates without commercial justification.
indicators.ctx: Price above or below a credible valuation.

indicators.name: Buyer indifferent to quality, authenticity or price
indicators.canon: Customer indifferent to cost, return or value
indicators.desc: Customer readily accepts poor terms, fees, losses, penalties or prices, showing little interest in performance, provenance or negotiation.
indicators.ctx: Little interest in provenance or negotiation.

indicators.name: Rapid resale or return for refund by cheque
indicators.canon: Rapid resale or return of recently acquired asset
indicators.desc: An asset is bought and quickly resold or returned for a refund in a different payment form, with no apparent reason or improvement.
indicators.ctx: Item bought then resold or returned for different payment form.

indicators.name: Use of freeports or offshore storage and shell owners
indicators.canon: High-value asset held through opaque vehicle
indicators.desc: Property, art, vessels or other valuables are acquired or held via a company, trust or storage arrangement with concealed beneficial owners.
indicators.ctx: Items held through opaque vehicles or storage.

indicators.name: Unclear provenance or sourcing of metals and stones
indicators.canon: Unclear provenance of gold, metals or stones
indicators.desc: Gold, metals or stones lack licence, assay or chain-of-custody evidence of origin, or are claimed as recycled scrap.
indicators.ctx: Gold or stones from unverified origin or recycled scrap.

indicators.name: Vehicle purchased for cash and exported quickly
indicators.canon: Vehicle purchased for cash and exported quickly
indicators.desc: Luxury cars bought and shipped abroad soon after.
indicators.ctx: Luxury cars bought and shipped abroad soon after.

indicators.name: Purchases inconsistent with customer profile
indicators.canon: Wealth or spending inconsistent with known means
indicators.desc: Assets, lifestyle spending or purchases clearly exceed the customer's known legitimate income or declared wealth, with no verifiable source.

indicators.name: Auction or intermediary used to obscure parties
indicators.canon: Auction or intermediary used to obscure parties
